name: weekly-numbers-narrator
description: Reads your weekly metrics spreadsheet (or a pasted table), computes in code what changed in the latest period versus the previous one (or the same week last month), picks the metrics that really moved, and writes a short 'what happened and why' paragraph in which every number is inserted by code. The 'why' comes only from the sheet's own notes column or context you type; without it the paragraph says the cause is not in the data. After you approve the exact text, it posts the paragraph to one chat channel. It never invents a cause or a number and never posts without approval.

skills.name: Weekly numbers narrative
skills.description: Week-over-week (or vs last month) changes in a metrics sheet, computed in code: movers above a 5% materiality bar with a noise check, flat metrics, and a checked paragraph whose numbers are code-inserted and whose causes come only from the sheet's notes or your context. Posts it to a chat channel after you approve it.
examples: Narrate this week's numbers from KPI sheet
